{{Quote|It's okay, Qwallo. You'll be fine as soon as we stop the bleeding.|Skywalker reassures Qwallo while using the scissors|<ref name="Aby" />}}
'''Laser scissors''' were a type of medical [[scissors]] used to cut and removed material during medical procedures. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] kept a pair in his [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], which he used in [[43 ABY]] to cut away the ruined leg of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qwallo Mode]]'s [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]], when he found Mode wounded in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].<ref name="Aby" />

==Behind the scenes==
Laser scissors first appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' which was written by [[Troy Denning]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
